messages:
Lara: quick sync - thinking of adding a 'route-quota-exempt' tag for low-volume internal routes so we don't apply digest sampling there. pros/cons?

Mike: sounds ok but we need to ensure exempt routes still go through redaction pipeline. exempt == No quota sampling, not no-redact.

Deepa: agree. also add telemetry flag `logging.route_exempt.count` so we can see how many exemptions exist.

Tom: UI: console should show an amber icon for exempt routes with hover text: 'Exempt from quota sampling; redaction still applies'. also add a bulk toggle per tenant.

Lara: policy: only routes tagged internal-debug or with owner-team=infra can be exempt by default. customer requests require support workflow.

Mike: ops: if exempted route receives >100 req/s for >5m, auto-remove exempt and notify owner. prevents accidental high-cost routes.

ops-bot: rule added to staging: auto-unset exempt if rate>100 for 5m and alert #eng-oncall. will report triggers. :robot_face:

Deepa: implementational note: exempt routes still produce digests but at full fidelity for troubleshooting. ensure HMAC keys applied.

Tom: add audit event `route.exempt.toggle` with actor, reason, and previous_state. critical for compliance.

Lara: action items: Mike to wire telemetry + auto-unset, Deepa to confirm redaction parity, Tom to add console badge + audit event. will review in 48h.

Mike: will start a short canary on staging and post numbers.

ops-bot: canary started: exempt-tag on 3 staging routes. will post summary at 6187654520.
